title: S11T06 - Add regression coverage for the git check matrix
description: Turn the reproduction matrix and classification contract into tests that prevent the false positives from returning.
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover the protected-main, dirty worktree, untracked generated ledger, memory layout, and clean checkout cases.
Tests assert JSON status, exit behavior, and recommendedActions for sync/doctor surfaces.
The suite can run locally in a temporary fixture repo without requiring destructive git operations in the developer workspace.
closedReason: Regression coverage accepted: the git check matrix cases required for Sprint 11 are represented in tests/runtime/cli.test.ts and full tests pass.
